name: E14 context decision value and observability
scope: same144 head-tiles,994 sets and common fixed legal candidate panels; no new states/QKV/video/MLP/global solving

A_estimands.requested: j_mean=argmax mean(g), compare mean max(0,g_i_best) minus mean max(0,g_i_jmean); per-state perfect acceptance explicitly oracle
A_estimands.strict_fixed: single action or no-op chosen before state: max(0,max_j mean(g_j))
A_estimands.strong_fixed_with_perfect_gate: j_plus=argmax_j mean(max(0,g_j)), same perfect state-dependent acceptance; pure conditional-ranking comparison

B_directions: Q16 per-query and aggregated basis-coordinate cosine: selected H versus true unselected E, report both signs; delta proxy=m_r h_r-m_a h_a versus e_r-e_a; random common rotations as null
B_projection: existing per-head rank8 basis; QR orthonormal basis for retained energy only; report basis condition number
B_targets: all unordered same-head set pairs, same candidate: (g(S2,a)-g(S1,a))/sigma_event; sigma_event=std of full anchor gain matrix, labels/evaluation only, never inference input

B_models.scalar: 4 state scalar differences, no pair dependence

B_fit: ridge without intercept on feature differences; train-only feature RMS, equal event weight and equal state-pair/action weight inside event; lambda1e-4,.01,1,100 chosen by development weightedMSE

B_ranking_panels.online_linear: same20-feature linear initial pair preference + predicted context correction; no teacher input
B_ranking_panels.oracle_initial_anchor: true initial g0/sigma plus predicted correction, offline isolation diagnostic
B_ranking_panels.true_conditional: same panel true labels + no-op oracle

B_static_probe: 20 pair features + intercept ridge, only initial Risk training labels centered by per-event mean and scaled by sigma_event; validation only selects regularization
B_eval: freeze coefficients before evaluation; no threshold tuning or gating; rank effects from same-score differences, positive-only teacher rejection separately diagnostic

B_modes.interaction_only: subtract action mean within each state pair from both features and target; isolates conditional ranking, scalar-only becomes zero
